H3_logdet_on_the_sphere.note: An extra variational principle, not a derived KMS condition. Yukawas are parameters in the archived model, not dynamical fields.
H3_logdet_on_the_sphere.note_kinetics: Because λ3 = 5-√5 < λ3' = 5+√5, log det is not Galois-symmetric and prefers putting mass on the lighter spatial 3. This is an extra variational principle, not a derived KMS condition.

classification.H3: CONDITIONAL (log-det is an extra principle, not KMS; kinetics split α and β)

next_obstruction: Maximum entropy on the residual sphere is uniform, not a point, and KMS does not apply to Yukawa parameters. If one extra principle is added — maximising log det(K+Σ) on the unit sphere with the Hodge kinetic — the unique maximiser (up to signs) is the pure 3⊗5 → 4_3 ray, because λ3 = 5−√5 is lighter than λ3′. That principle is not derived.
